amsterdam-ii.l: At least 3 relatives with a cancer in the Amsterdam II spectrum. Covered by the "3-2-1" mnemonic.
One of them is a FIRST-DEGREE relative of the other two. NOT covered by the "3-2-1" mnemonic - this is one of the three requirements the mnemonic omits.
At least 2 successive generations affected. Covered by the "3-2-1" mnemonic.
At least one diagnosed before age 50. Covered by the "3-2-1" mnemonic.
Familial adenomatous polyposis excluded in the colorectal cases. NOT covered by the "3-2-1" mnemonic - this is one of the three requirements the mnemonic omits.
Tumors verified by pathological examination. NOT covered by the "3-2-1" mnemonic - this is one of the three requirements the mnemonic omits.
Are all three cancers colorectal? Used only for the Amsterdam I comparison, whose spectrum was colorectal cancer only.
